name: Calke Explore Natural Play, Calke Abbey
description: Natural play with a human-sized badger sett to crawl into, tree trunks to balance on and fallen branches for den building. There's a short trail suitable for wheelchairs and mobility scooters.
fee: Non-members pay for the park and gardens: £8.50 adult, £4.25 child (5–17), £21.25 family; under-5s free
